map.调车作业效率优化工具按输入参数评估编组、取送与解体作业效率并给出优化建议，适合铁: The shunting (operations / efficiency) optimization tool evaluates classification, pickup-delivery and break-up efficiency from input parameters and offers optimization advice, suited to railway station operations organization and dispatch efficiency.
map.效率 = 输出 ÷ 输入 × 100%，损耗 = 输入 - 输出: Efficiency = output ÷ input × 100%, loss = input − output
map.编组站作业：统计每班计划调车作业量与有效完成量，量化作业效率与待解待编积压。: Yard operations: tabulate planned shunting moves and effective completions per shift to quantify operating efficiency and the backlog of cars awaiting classification and assembly.
map.取送车优化：对比取送批次与单机走行，核算有效作业占比，减少空行程损耗。: Pickup and delivery optimization: compare pickup batches with single-machine travel, compute the effective share and cut empty-travel waste.
map.解体溜放组织：按解体钩数、禁溜与分组，评估设备（驼峰）利用率与瓶颈环节。: Hump break-up organization: assess hump (device) utilisation and bottleneck links from break-up hook counts, no-hump cars and grouping.
map.以某编组站乙班计划调车作业 120 钩、有效完成 108 钩: Take a marshalling station night shift with 120 planned shunting moves and 108 effectively completed
map.：作业效率=有效完成÷计划作业×100%=108÷120×100=90.0%；损: : operating efficiency = effective completion ÷ planned work ×100% = 108÷120×100=90.0%; loss = planned − effective = 120−108=12 moves (including repeated break-up, waiting for transfer and plan adjustments). If losses rise to 24~30 moves (efficiency 80%~85%), investigate pickup/delivery travel, locomotive coordination and plan quality.
map.本工具取“有效完成量÷计划作业量×100%”作为作业效率，损耗=计划−有效。它反: This tool takes "effective output ÷ planned work × 100%" as operating efficiency, with loss = planned − effective. It reflects plan fulfilment and process waste, a common process metric for station operations organization rather than locomotive or equipment technical efficiency.
map.效率偏低通常卡在哪？: Where does low efficiency usually get stuck?
map.常见瓶颈：取送车与解编设备（驼峰/牵出线）能力不匹配、单机空行程多、计划编制质量: Common bottlenecks: pickup/delivery and hump classification capacity mismatch, excessive single-machine empty travel, poor plan quality causing repeated work, and poor peak-tail to classification-tail coordination. Improvement means cutting invalid travel, balancing peak-tail and classification-tail load, and raising first-time plan quality.
